title: Raven Gloves
summary: Summon Quothe the Raven, a flying familiar that can Blind enemies.

fields.Summon: Level 3, Action, 60 ft range, once per Short Rest. Quothe has 1 HP and AC 12. Unequipping the gloves dismisses it. You cannot keep it alongside another Find Familiar summon.
fields.Familiar actions: Fly for movement. Beak Attack is a melee Action that deals 1 + Dexterity modifier Piercing on hit. Rend Vision is a melee unarmed Action, dealing 1 Piercing on hit and Blinding until the start of the target’s turn, with no save. The raven’s extra attack lasts only its first turn.
fields.Tooltip discrepancy: The tooltip says a hostile killer must make a Dexterity save to avoid Ensnared. The source reports this never actually applies.
fields.Acquisition: Reward from He Who Was for Punish the Wicked.
fields.Base value: 160 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
